أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar, [which is] mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: khabar. ﴿لَهُنَّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير. ﴿وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and سميع and عليم are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمى حَرَجٌ﴾: ليس is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and حرج is its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿حَرَجٌ﴾: postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَلا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا عَلى أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿أَنْ تَأْكُلُوا﴾: أن makes the verb accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar), [which is] mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تأكلوا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَوْ بُيُوتِ﴾: conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿آبائِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوانِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَواتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمامِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوالِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خالاتِكُمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, conjoined to what precedes. ﴿مَلَكْتُمْ مَفاتِحَهُ﴾: a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil, مفاتحه its object, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ﴾: conjoined to what precedes. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿جُناحٌ﴾: the postponed noun of ليس; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ تَأْكُلُوا﴾: أن makes the verb accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَوْ أَشْتاتاً﴾: conjoined to جميعا. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) containing the sense of condition; the statement is resumptive. ﴿دَخَلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بُيُوتاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَسَلِّمُوا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer of إذا, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no position because it is the answer of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿عَلى أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سلموا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَحِيَّةً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of تحية. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿طَيِّبَةً﴾: a second adjective of تحية. ﴿مُبارَكَةً﴾: also an adjective. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition and the demonstrative is in the position of genitive; [the two are] attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, with the Name of Majesty as its fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يبين. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعلّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl), with no position. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ.

daas-irab:62-62.t: ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾: the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative [noun], khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنوا. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an adverb (ẓarf) containing the sense of condition. ﴿كانُوا﴾: كان (of kāna and its sisters) and its noun; the clause is the ṣila. [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the clause after إذا is parsed as muḍāf ilayhi.] ﴿مَعَهُ﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿عَلى أَمْرٍ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿جامِعٍ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of أمر. ﴿لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا﴾: لم makes the verb jussive, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no position because it is the answer of a condition that does not make the verb jussive. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit and of the genitive. ﴿يَسْتَأْذِنُوهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after حتى; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), [with the preposition] are attached to يذهبوا. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: إنّ, and the relative noun is its noun. ﴿يَسْتَأْذِنُونَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar. [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause is the ṣila of الذين.] ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, khabar; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمنون. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَإِذَا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and an adverb containing the sense of condition; the statement is resumptive. ﴿اسْتَأْذَنُوكَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila. [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the clause after إذا is parsed as muḍāf ilayhi.] ﴿لِبَعْضِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يستأذنوك. ﴿شَأْنِهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأْذَنْ﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer of إذا, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause has no position. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: من is a relative [noun], and [the two are] attached to the verb. ﴿شِئْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شئت. ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَهُمُ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: إنّ, its noun and its two khabars; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl), with no position.

daas-irab:63-64.t: ﴿لا﴾: prohibitive. ﴿تَجْعَلُوا دُعاءَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and ﴿دُعاءَ﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿الرَّسُولِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَدُعاءِ﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), second mafʿūl bihi, and دعاء is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَعْضِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَعْضاً﴾: mafʿūl bihi of دعاء. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, with the Name of Majesty as its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَتَسَلَّلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿لِواذاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلْيَحْذَرِ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, fāʿil; the clause has no position. ﴿يُخالِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَنْ أَمْرِهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb before it; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the hāʾ is its object and فتنة its postponed fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذابٌ﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it and parsed like it. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿أَلا﴾: an opening particle (adāt istiftāḥ). ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; [the two are] attached to the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun], the noun of إنّ. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of verification. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿ما﴾: a relative [noun], mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يُرْجَعُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is a relative [noun]; [the two are] attached to ينبئهم. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾: preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾: khabar; the clause is resumptive.
